notes.title: Update
notes.content:
A small update for the game.

[*] A Leaderboard has now been integrated; destroy a couple of dots and return to the main menu too upload your Dot count to the leaderboard.
[*] This leaderboard is accessible from the main menu, under Global Scores.
[*] Upgrades are now available for four of the weapons; Upgrades can be accessed from the main menu, under Dot Destroyer.
[*] The laser has changed, it's now a slow moving laser beam that follows the mouse curser instead of being tied to mouse position. This was to give it upgrade potential.
[*] Fullscreen issues should have been fixed, if you're still having problems then please let us know.

A new timed Dot mode has been completed and hopefully pushed to the game soon, the delay is caused by Leaderboard problems. Thank you for your patience.
